frozen_before: any fetch or view of data before 2025-10-01 for this basket
origin: log/2026-10-12/init7-horizon-study/result.json: 20d reversal was the only one of 12 selector/horizon variants whose interval cleared the 13.29 bps base hurdle on 2025-10-01..2026-10-08; 10 non-overlapping trades, so it is a hypothesis

rule.signal: 20-session close-to-close return of each name minus QQQ's, measured to the decision close
rule.selection: the name with the lowest relative return, only if its own 20-session return < 0 and its relative return < 0; otherwise hold cash
rule.prices: daily SIP bars, split- and dividend-adjusted (adjustment=all)

test.trades: non-overlapping, one decision every 20 sessions from offset 0; all 20 offsets reported as a robustness check
test.pass: mean excess over QQQ per non-overlapping trade > 13.29 bps AND moving-block (block 20) bootstrap 2.5% bound of the overlapping excess series > 0 AND both halves of the window have positive mean excess
test.known_bias: survivorship: the basket is today's megacaps; GOOGL/META/TSLA weights in QQQ changed over the window
